recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-46017; any future correction to the shared language-communication extension should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-46017 was an Applied FHIR-core Patient Administration change request, resolved Persuasive, asking for ExtendedContactDetail to indicate the languages a particular contact uses with zero-to-many cardinality. The approved resolution was to make the extension from FHIR-46016 available for ExtendedContactDetail as well.
initial_application: FHIR Extension Pack commit 329b91da5d9586173eec0f68430f3a68e40cb42d applied FHIR-46017 together with FHIR-46016 by adding ExtendedContactDetail as a context on input/definitions/Location/StructureDefinition-location-communication.xml and by changing the extension cardinality from 0..1 to 0..*.
additional_context: The same Extension Pack source file carries the FHIR-46016 Organization and OrganizationAffiliation contexts, and later Extension Pack QA changes retained the ExtendedContactDetail context while adding version-specific-use metadata. The current FHIR-core checkout no longer owns the standard extension StructureDefinition source and retains only the extension OID mapping; ExtendedContactDetail remains an active core datatype and the metadata page links to Extension Pack extension listings.
reconciliation: An empty external-repo audit commit is present on the combined branch. No FHIR-core source was changed because the requested ExtendedContactDetail applicability is already present in HL7/fhir-extensions, which is the source of truth for this extension.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-46017 explicitly reuses the FHIR-46016 communication extension and was applied in the same Extension Pack commit.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive request to make the FHIR-46016 language-communication extension available for ExtendedContactDetail at zero-to-many.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the follow-on issue request and final disposition.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue widening location-communication and later noting that contexts were added to the existing extension.
evidence_items.learned: This identifies the same extension family and confirms why FHIR-46017 should be checked against location-communication.

evidence_items.summary: The current Extension Pack source includes an ExtendedContactDetail context and Extension.max='*'.
evidence_items.learned: The requested ExtendedContactDetail applicability and repeatability are present in the external source of truth.

evidence_items.summary: Applied FHIR-46017 together with FHIR-46016 by adding ExtendedContactDetail context and changing max from 1 to *.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-46017 was implemented in the Extension Pack rather than the core checkout.

evidence_items.summary: Core commit removed location-communication and other extension definitions from R5 source.
evidence_items.learned: The current FHIR-core checkout is not the authoritative source location for this extension definition.

evidence_items.summary: ExtendedContactDetail is active in fhir.ini and the metadata page links to Extension Pack extension listings for ExtendedContactDetail.
evidence_items.learned: Core source already directs implementers to the external extension listing surface.

evidence_items.summary: PA minutes reference FHIR-46017 and discuss whether the FHIR-46016 extension is duplicative if language is attached to ExtendedContactDetail.
evidence_items.learned: The WG discussion supports an extension-context interpretation rather than a new core datatype element.

evidence_items.summary: Discussion of FHIR-46016/FHIR-46017 cardinality widening treated changing the standard extension from 0..1 to 0..* as not breaking in the same sense as a property.
evidence_items.learned: This supports the applied approach of retaining the existing extension with widened cardinality.

evidence_items.locator: Combined branch idempotency and empty-commit checks
evidence_items.summary: The combined branch contains commit 9952f3b132ffc473217421eb356ca36aabb08ee3 for FHIR-46017, and its tree is identical to its parent.
evidence_items.learned: The required audit commit is present on the combined branch and is intentionally empty.
